Name: Twins Minigame
Description: An endless platformer about a pair of twins: spawn the second and switch between them in mid-air to keep going.

Achievements.Name: Conjoined
Achievements.Description: Get 800 points in Twins mode in one session

Achievements.Name: Bipolar
Achievements.Description: Change side more than 50 times in one session

Achievements.Name: Last fortune
Achievements.Description: Make a jump that leads to a certain death, but get some coins in your way!

Achievements.Name: No love
Achievements.Description: Let the twin crash right after spawning it 5 consecutives times in a game.
